;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2014 pro-Russian unrest in Ukraine]]:
**Ukrainian billionaire [[Rinat Akhmetov]] asks workers to stage a peace rally in the [[Donetsk]] region in protest against the self-proclaimed [[Donetsk People's Republic]]. [http://en.interfax.com.ua/news/general/205526.html (Interfax)] [http://www.themoscowtimes.com/news/article/akhmetov-asks-donetsk-workforce-to-protest-against-separatists/500480.html (''The Moscow Times'')]
*Two explosions occur near a crowded market in the Nigerian city of [[Jos]] killing at least 118 people.  [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-27493940 (BBC News)] [https://sg.news.yahoo.com/nigeria-car-bombing-death-toll-least-118-relief-201927056.html (AFP via Yahoo! News Singapore)]
*[[Shia insurgency in Yemen]]
**At least 16 people are killed in clashes between [[Shi'ite]] Muslim tribesmen and [[Yemeni government]] forces and allied [[Sunni]] tribesmen. [https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/05/20/us-yemen-violence-idUSBREA4J08320140520?feedType=RSS (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*American car maker [[General Motors]] recalls another 2.4 million vehicles. [https://money.cnn.com/2014/05/20/autos/gm-recall/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Credit Suisse]] pleads guilty to helping American citizens evade taxes and agrees to a [[US$]]2.6&nbsp;billion fine. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/economy/credit-suisse-charged-in-tax-evasion-case/2014/05/19/772afeb2-dfb0-11e3-9743-bb9b59cde7b9_story.html?tid=hpModule_79c38dfc-8691-11e2-9d71-f0feafdd1394 (''Washington Post'')]
*A truck going from [[Florida]] to [[Maine]] carrying about 1.5 to 2 million bees crashes.[http://bangordailynews.com/2014/05/21/business/millions-of-bees-in-delaware-accident-were-headed-for-maine/ (''Bangor Daily News'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*At least 17 people are killed and 27 injured after a bus plunges into a gorge in India's [[Jammu and Kashmir (state)|Jammu and Kashmir]] state. [http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/17-killed-27-injured-in-Jammu-Kashmir-road-accident/articleshow/35366278.cms? (''Times of India'')]
*[[Russian media]] reports that a passenger train has [[Naro-Fominsk rail crash|collided with a derailed freight]] train near [[Moscow]] killing at least six people. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-27484148 (BBC News)]
*The [[United States Coast Guard]] resumes its search for four British sailors lost in the mid-Atlantic. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-27492026# (BBC News)]

;International relations
*The [[President of Russia]] [[Vladimir Putin]] arrives in the [[People's Republic of China]] for a state visit. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-27481454 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*American actor [[Michael Jace]] is arrested in relation to the shooting death of his wife in [[Los Angeles, California|Los Angeles]]. [http://www.theage.com.au/lifestyle/celebrity/michael-jace-star-of-the-shield-arrested-after-shooting-death-of-his-wife-in-los-angeles-20140520-zrj90.html (AFP via ''Melbourne Age'')]
*Three female children, ages 2 months to 3 years, are stabbed to death at a home in [[Torrance, California|Torrance]], [[California]], U.S. The children's mother is arrested and charged with murder. [http://www.cnn.com/2014/05/21/justice/california-children-deaths/index.html?hpt=hp_t3 (CNN)] 

;Politics and elections
*[[2013–14 Thai political crisis]]:
**The [[Royal Thai Army]] declares [[martial law]] after six months of political unrest. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2014/may/20/thai-army-declares-martial-law-amid-unrest (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Narendra Modi]] is officially re-elected as the leader of the [[Bharatiya Janata Party]] and the [[National Democratic Alliance (India)|National Democratic Alliance]] ahead of being sworn in as the [[Prime Minister of India]]. [http://indianexpress.com/article/india/politics/live-narendra-modi-to-be-elected-leader-of-bjp-nda-coalition-today/ (''Indian Express'')]
*[[Malawian general election, 2014|Malawian general election]]:
**Voters in [[Malawi]] go to the polls for a general election. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-27477351 (BBC News)]
